versions.subject: rules: lsass dumps
versions.detection:
selection1:
    TargetFilename|endswith: 
        - '\lsass.dmp'
        - '\lsass.zip'
        - '\lsass.rar'
selection2:
    TargetFilename|contains:
        - '\lsass_2'  # default format of procdump v9.0 is lsass_YYMMDD_HHmmss.dmp
        - '\lsassdump'
        - '\lsassdmp'
condition: selection1 or selection2
versions.spl: TargetFilename IN ("*\\lsass.dmp", "*\\lsass.zip", "*\\lsass.rar") OR TargetFilename IN ("*\\lsass_2*", "*\\lsassdump*", "*\\lsassdmp*")
